title: Inverse Obstacle Scattering from Multi-Frequency Near-Field Backscattering Data
summary: This paper addresses the inverse obstacle scattering problem of simultaneously reconstructing the obstacle geometry and boundary conditions from multi-frequency near-field backscattering data. We first establish rigorous high-frequency asymptotic expansions for the scattered near-field, leveraging pseudo-differential operators (PDOs) to characterize the interaction between wavefront propagation and obstacle boundaries, where the principal symbol of the PDO governs the leading-order behavior of the scattering field.
